requirement: Confirm API terms, robots.txt, usage policies, and redistribution limits before crawling or storing data.
Set connector-specific rate limits, retries, and backoff to avoid abusive access patterns.
Define how long raw source HTML/API payloads stay in S3 and who can access them.
Classify provider directory data and avoid collecting patient data or unrelated PII.
Store source URL, retrieved timestamp, parser version, confidence formula version, and reviewer disposition.
Use state/license sources for license status; do not infer license validity from NPPES alone.
Send only necessary public text snippets to Bedrock or any model endpoint; log prompt/version/output.
Require review for stale, conflicting, high-risk, peer-mismatched, or identity-level changes.
Support rollback and correction workflow for contested updates.
Monitor source freshness, connector failures, false positives, review backlog, and cost drift.
